basic_profile.bio: I'm a math enthusiast with a deep interest in traditional archery. Originally from the Pacific Northwest, I spend a lot of my free time honing my skills in archery and exploring the mathematical patterns in nature. I work as a data analyst for a tech company, which allows me to merge my love for numbers with my career. I'm usually online during the evenings after work hours and enjoy engaging in discussions about niche topics, such as werewolf lore. Currently in a long-term relationship, I enjoy sharing my hobbies with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Mathematics and have always been passionate about numbers. My interest in archery started as a hobby a few years back and quickly turned into a way of life. I enjoy researching and learning about traditional techniques and historical aspects of archery, often sharing insights in related subreddits. My curiosity about folklore and mythology is mostly self-taught, fueled by books and online communities.
